notes.title: DLC & Update
notes.content:
🎉 New DLC: Skin Pack! 🎉
We’ve added a big batch of skins you can use in-game!

If you enjoy the clicker and want to support us — this is a simple way to do it. The DLC doesn’t give any gameplay advantage, just some extra style and vibes :)

Thanks for playing ❤️

Update v1.0.11
Added warning before buying auto-fishing rod.
Added information about the number of island resets.
All purchased items have been removed from the store.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3606650/Island_Clicker__Skin_Pack/

notes.title: Update v1.0.8
notes.content:
The New Year event has ended.
The chance to encounter a secret boss in the arena has been increased.
The auto-fishing rod now supports time skipping for diamonds.
Resources from geodes now depend on your tool's level.
Bug fixes.

notes.title: Update v1.0.7
notes.content:
Added a button to the converter to exchange all resources at once.
Bug fixes.

notes.title: Update v1.0.6 Winter event
notes.content:
Added a holiday event, a Christmas tree appeared on the map, after clicking you will get to a new place.
Fixed several visual bugs.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: Fixed an issue where it was impossible to complete a new quest if you had a reset trophy.

notes.title: Update v1.0.5
notes.content:
Added 3 new quests.
Some crafts now require more wood.
Some items in the converter have been changed.
Fixed several visual errors.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: Fixed display of products in the store.

notes.title: Update v1.0.3.1
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the arena timer would not turn on.

notes.title: Update v1.0.3
notes.content:
Added a new location in the radioactive world.
Introduced a new sieving mechanic.
Added a new resource — sand.
Parts are now harder to obtain: the maximum you can get from one boss is 2 pieces.
Quests now have a reward limit: you can earn a maximum of 50 units per quest, plus a bonus for resetting the trophy.
The store now displays the number of your autoclickers.
Added protection against accidental destruction of items in the inventory.
Added the ability to access pets directly without entering the house.
Minor optimization for the arena when you have a large number of autoclickers.
Fixed autoclicker display: if you have more than 1,000, they now display correctly without being cut off.
Fixed a bug where players couldn’t receive the bonus for resetting the trophy.

notes.title: Update News and Steam Cloud Save
notes.content:
At your request, we've added a new feature to the game: mining rare stones and other resources! A new zone has appeared in the radioactive location where you can sift through sand and find not only rare stones but also other useful materials. This update will be released in a few days.

In addition, we are pleased to announce the addition of cloud saves on Steam. If you encounter any problems with your saves, please let us know.

In the near future, we plan to add a leaderboard specifically for the new arena. Stay tuned for updates!

Let's make the game even cooler together! Leave your feedback and suggestions so we can create a community where every player feels heard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174259/122cb7e79c440c289f9c6a13c1e28ebde8eb6924.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update v1.0.2
notes.content:
Added a setting to mute all sounds with a single toggle.
Added the ability to instantly upgrade a tool to the next bonus level.
Added the option to switch to full-screen mode.

notes.title: Small Update: Interface Improvements
notes.content: Added button highlighting on hover for most buttons to make the interface more interactive and user-friendly.

notes.title: Thank you for playing!
notes.content:
[h2]Thank you for playing Island Clicker![/h2]

We’re absolutely delighted to see so many of you playing and enjoying the game! 🌴🪙

[h2]Your Feedback Matters[/h2]
We want you to know that we’re carefully reading all your reviews and feedback. Your thoughts are incredibly important to us, and we’ll do our best to make the game even better with your help.

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]
We’re already planning our first update! Based on your feedback, we’re reworking the cooking system and making visual improvements to enhance the overall experience. Stay tuned for details!

[h2]Join the Discussion[/h2]
Got ideas for new features, improvements, or just want to share your experience? Let’s talk! You can join the discussion in our [url=https://discord.gg/qNZFtB5ngW]Discord[/url] server or right here in the Steam Community Discussions.

[b]Thank you for being part of this journey. This is only the beginning! 💖
[/b]
